title: Decision and labeled branches
code:
flowchart TD
A[Request] --> B{Valid?}
B -->|Yes| C(Accept)
B -->|No| D[Reject]
description: Four nodes, three directed edges and both branch labels.

title: Chained connections
code:
flowchart LR
A[Start] --> B[Work] --> C[Done]
description: Every node and edge in a chained statement must survive parsing.

title: Compact arrows and hyphenated IDs
code:
flowchart LR
client-app-->api-service
api-service-.->db
description: Arrows need no surrounding spaces, and hyphens inside IDs do not split nodes.

title: Single-line diagram
code: graph LR; A[Start] --> B[Work]; B --> C[Done];
description: Semicolons separate the header and statements.

title: LR direction
code:
flowchart LR
A[First] --> B[Second]
B --> C[Third]
description: Preserve source-to-target arrows while placing nodes in the requested direction.

title: RL direction
code:
flowchart RL
A[First] --> B[Second]
B --> C[Third]
description: Preserve source-to-target arrows while placing nodes in the requested direction.

title: TB direction
code:
flowchart TB
A[First] --> B[Second]
B --> C[Third]
description: Preserve source-to-target arrows while placing nodes in the requested direction.

title: BT direction
code:
flowchart BT
A[First] --> B[Second]
B --> C[Third]
description: Preserve source-to-target arrows while placing nodes in the requested direction.

title: Labels declared after an edge
code:
flowchart TD
A --> B
B[Destination] --> C[Finish]
A[Origin]
description: Explicit labels replace implicit IDs even in later edge statements.

title: Circle and subroutine shapes
description: Nested shape delimiters must not leak into labels or drop edges.

title: Solid, dotted, thick and undirected links
code:
flowchart LR
A --> B
B -.-> C
C ==> D
D --- E
description: Undirected links have no arrowhead; other line styles remain distinct.

title: Return edge and self-loop
code:
flowchart TD
A[Ready] --> B[Work]
B -->|retry| A
B -->|again| B
description: Cycles terminate and self-loops have visible area.

title: Quotes, punctuation and multiline labels
code:
flowchart TD A["A; B & "] --> B["First
Second"]
description: XML is escaped, quotes are syntax, and line breaks are displayed as lines.

title: Subgraphs
code:
flowchart TD
subgraph Services
A --> B
end
description: Grouping is not implemented: retain source rather than flattening away its meaning.

title: Aliases, numbering and note
code:
sequenceDiagram
autonumber
participant C as Client
participant S as Server
C->>S: Request
S-->>C: Response
Note over S,C: Shared note
description: Two lifelines, numbered messages and a reversed spanning note.

title: Nested branches and self-message
code:
sequenceDiagram
participant A
participant B
alt ready
loop retry
A->>B: Work
B-->>B: Check
end
else wait
B-->>A: Later
end
description: Nested frames reserve separate space for headings and messages.

title: Activation shorthand
code:
sequenceDiagram
A->>+B: Work
B-->>-A: Done
description: Activation bars are not implemented: do not create spurious +B and -A participants.

title: Start, finish and aliases
code:
stateDiagram-v2
state "Waiting" as W
[*] --> W
W --> Done:go
Done --> [*]
description: Identity is independent of display text; start and end are distinct.

title: Branching, returns and multiline labels
code:
stateDiagram-v2 direction LR [*] --> A A --> B:accept A --> C:reject B --> A:retry
later C --> [*]
description: Branching transitions and multiline return labels stay legible.

title: Composite states
description: Composite-state hierarchy is not implemented; retain the complete source.

title: State notes
code:
stateDiagram-v2
A --> B
note right of B: Important
description: State notes are not implemented; do not silently discard them.

title: Attributes and methods
description: Class bodies and colon member syntax preserve attributes and methods.

title: Comments inside a class
description: Comments are not members; a brace need not be preceded by a space.

title: Inheritance arrow direction
code:
classDiagram
Animal <|-- Duck
description: The hollow triangle belongs at Animal, the superclass.

title: Aggregation and composition
code:
classDiagram
Team o-- Member
Team *-- Record
description: Aggregation uses a hollow diamond; composition uses a filled diamond at the owner.

title: Association, dependency and realization
code:
classDiagram
A --> B
B ..> C
C ..|> D
D -- E
description: Solid association, dashed dependency, hollow realization triangle and plain link are distinct.

title: Multiplicity labels
code:
classDiagram
Customer "1" --> "*" Order : owns
description: Multiplicity annotations are not implemented; retain source instead of dropping the relationship.

title: One-to-many relationship
description: Entities, attributes, key constraints and relationship labels are retained.

title: All cardinalities
code:
erDiagram
A |o--o| B : optional
B ||--|| C : exactly
C }o--o{ D : many
D }|--|{ E : required
description: Both ends accept the documented zero/one/many cardinalities.

title: Non-identifying relationship
code:
erDiagram
PERSON }|..|{ CAR : drives
description: Two dots denote a dashed, non-identifying relationship.

title: Isolated entity
code:
erDiagram
CUSTOMER
description: An entity may be declared without attributes or relationships.

title: Comment before the diagram header
code:
%% explanation
flowchart TD
A --> B
description: A leading comment must not prevent type detection.

title: Empty Flowchart diagram
code: flowchart TD
description: Empty diagrams keep source visible instead of replacing it with a blank SVG.

title: Empty Class diagram
code: classDiagram
description: Empty diagrams keep source visible instead of replacing it with a blank SVG.

title: Empty ER diagram
code: erDiagram
description: Empty diagrams keep source visible instead of replacing it with a blank SVG.

title: Pie (unsupported family)
code:
pie title Pets
"Cats" : 5
"Dogs" : 3
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: Gantt (unsupported family)
code:
gantt
title Release
dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
section Work
Build :a, 2026-10-01, 5d
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: Mindmap (unsupported family)
code:
mindmap
  root((Project))
    Code
    Tests
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: Timeline (unsupported family)
code:
timeline
title Release
2026 : Build : Ship
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: Journey (unsupported family)
code:
journey
title Checkout
section Buy
Pay: 5: User
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: Git graph (unsupported family)
code:
gitGraph
commit
branch develop
checkout develop
commit
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.

title: XY chart (unsupported family)
code:
xychart-beta
x-axis [Jan, Feb]
y-axis "Sales" 0 --> 10
bar [3, 7]
description: This family is outside the built-in renderer; source fallback is the expected result.
